install_methods.label: Install via Go
install_methods.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y golang && go install -v github.com/owasp-amass/amass/v4/...@main

install_methods.label: Install on Termux
install_methods.command: pkg update && pkg install -y golang git && git clone https://github.com/owasp-amass/amass.git && cd amass && go mod tidy && go build -o $PREFIX/bin/amass
